# New renderings chosen in iliad-098 (15.653–746)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀξίνη beside πέλεκυς (15.711, ὀξέσι πελέκεσσι καὶ ἀξίνῃσι; the table has both as "axe") | "axes" · "battle-axes" | "axes" · "battle-axes" | "axes and axes" (two words in one line cannot both be "axe"), "hatchets" (avoided at 13.611 and 21.120), "double-axes"; πέλεκυς keeps the table’s "axe" (21.120), and ἀξίνη takes "battle-axe" only where the two stand together |
| μελάνδετος (φάσγανα καλὰ μελάνδετα κωπήεντα, 15.713) | "dark-bound" | "dark-bound" (+ note: what is bound dark is not known) | "black-hilted" (κώπη is separately "hilt"), "black-studded", "dark-hilted"; μέλας + δετός "bound" |
| κωπήεις (15.713) | "hilted" | "hilted" | "with handles"; from κώπη "hilt" (table: ἀργυρέη κώπη "a hilt of silver") |
| ἄφλαστον (15.717) | "the stern-ornament" | "the stern-ornament" (+ note: exact form not known) | "the curved stern-post", "the figurehead", "the taffrail", "the poop" |
| κολλητὸν βλήτροισι (15.678; βλῆτρον sense uncertain) | "glued with clamps" | "glued together with clamps" (+ note: sense of βλῆτρον uncertain) | "glued with rivets", "fitted with rings", "fastened with bands", "joined"; κολλητός keeps the table’s κολλήεις "glued" (15.389), βλῆτρον is the uncertain part |
| δυωκαιεικοσίπηχυς (15.678) | "twenty-two cubits long" | "twenty-two cubits long" | "thirty feet" (the unit is the cubit, glossed in the note), "ten metres" |
| θρῆνυς ἑπταπόδης (15.729) | "seven-foot footstool" | "the seven-foot footstool" (+ note: some raised part of the ship, exact fitting not known) | "rowing bench", "gangway", "step", "foot-board", "stool" alone; θρῆνυς is footstool in the dictionaries |
| λαοφόρος ὁδός (15.682) | "the people-bearing road" | "the road that carries the people" | "highway", "public road", "main road", "busy road" |
| κελητίζειν ἵπποισι (15.679) | "to ride horses" | "how to ride horses" | "to ride in the circus", "to vault between horses" (the vaulting is what the simile then describes) |
| ἀμείβεται (of the rider changing horses, 15.684) | "changes" | "leaps … from one horse to another" (the leaping carried by θρῴσκων) | "answers" (kept for speech, as in the table’s ἀμείβετο), "exchanges" |
| δριμεῖα μάχη (15.696) | "sharp fighting" | "sharp fighting" | "bitter battle", "fierce fight"; μάχη stays "fighting" as in the table (12.436), δριμύς "sharp, keen" |
| ἀϊκάς (τόξων ἀϊκάς, 15.709; sense uncertain) | "the rush of arrows from bows" | "the rush of arrows from bows" (+ note: sense uncertain) | "volleys", "shots", "points" (each picks a sense) |
| ἔφεπ’ ἔγχεϊ (without an object, 15.742) | "went after them with the sharp spear" | "went raging after them with his sharp spear" | "attacked", "charged", "plied his spear"; ἐφέπω "go after" |
| ἦ, καί (15.742) | "He spoke, and" | "So he said, and" | follows iliad-019 and iliad-065 unchanged |
| ἐσσυμένως (ὡς ἐσσυμένως ἐμάχοντο, 15.698) | "so eagerly" | "so eagerly" | "hurriedly" / "in haste" (the table’s 3.84 rendering, which fits ἔσχοντο μάχης there but not the fighting here); ἐσσύμενος "eager" (11.716) |
